source: Zheng, Zhang, Qu, Wu, Ji, Zhang, Xia, Fang, Zhang, Chang et al. 2026, Palaeogeography, Palaeoclimatology, Palaeoecology (U-Pb calibration of Sinotyrannus kazuoensis), Fig. 7: time-calibrated tyrannosauroid tree against the Middle Jurassic to Late Cretaceous time scale; rectangular, root at the left. Image: census 3 figure, the embedded raster.
names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names (binomials)
gold_note: Rectangular time tree with a stage scale along the top, silhouettes beside several tips and a palaeogeographic map in the lower right. Proceratosauridae (five tips) and Stokesosauridae (four tips) are each drawn as one vertical with all their branches leaving it: polytomies. The bottom branch of Pantyrannosauria ends in a long empty oval with no name (presumably later tyrannosauroids); it is left out, so its node is not encoded. Clade names printed along the stems are kept; the numbered and coloured ovals (age dates, map localities) are not. 11 tips, 2 polytomies (5, 4 children); 4 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 10 case (census 3, seed 20261274). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
